[SWS_UCM_00098]
⌊
DRAFT
g
Software Package
Authentication failure
⌈
UCM
shall raise the
ApplicationError AuthenticationFailed
, if the
Software
Package
authentication check fails.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00013, RS_UCM_00019, RS_UCM_-
00025)
This error can happen when
TransferData
,
TransferExit
and
ProcessSwPack-
age
methods are called. When
AuthenticationFailed
error is raised, it is up to
client to decide if a
DeleteTransfer
will be called or not. The behaviour may vary
depending on the life cycle, meaning R&D phase or on the field phase.
